name: kelch like ECH associated protein 1
pathways: negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: KEAP1 encodes kelch-like ECH-associated protein 1. Annotated molecular activities include transcription regulator inhibitor activity and RNA polymerase II-specific DNA-binding transcription factor binding. It participates in negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and protein ubiquitination.
